open_points.subject: startup orphan-value detection
open_points.text: On start, temporary files, value bytes no record names ... are removed
open_points.question: Exactly which durable references make value bytes "named" and therefore exempt from removal?
options: Any StoredValue record carrying the digest is sufficient
At least one other retained record must refer to the StoredValue by value_id
Any direct or indirect reference from any durable record is sufficient
open_points.default_guess: Keep the bytes when any durable StoredValue record names their digest, including when several StoredValues of different schema or class share it.

open_points.subject: failed trial-fixture publication
open_points.text: the only trace it can leave is a published file no record names ... value bytes no record names ... are removed
open_points.question: Does startup also remove an unreferenced trial-fixture file published by a failed call, or does "value bytes" exclude the separately named file-fixture area?
options: Remove unreferenced value bytes and unreferenced file fixtures
Remove only value-carriage bytes; leave unreferenced file fixtures
Treat trial-fixture bytes as value bytes for this cleanup rule
open_points.default_guess: Remove every unreferenced content-addressed file, including an unreferenced trial fixture left by a failed call.

open_points.subject: orphan-value cleanup failure
open_points.text: On start ... value bytes no record names ... are removed; nothing else is. A spool directory that cannot be removed does not stop the start
open_points.question: What happens when an unreferenced value-byte file cannot be removed: must startup fail, or may startup continue as it explicitly may for an unremovable spool directory?
options: Continue, never serve the orphan, and retry at a later start
open_points.default_guess: Refuse to start because the non-fatal exception is stated only for spool-directory removal.

open_points.subject: startup cleanup and recovery
open_points.text: On start ... value bytes no record names ... are removed
open_points.question: Does orphan-value cleanup occur before or after A14 startup recovery, which can rerun work and cause equal orphan bytes to become named?
options: Clean before recovery, so recovery rewrites any needed equal bytes
Run recovery first, then remove bytes still unnamed
open_points.default_guess: Acquire the store and perform orphan cleanup before A14 recovery.
